changelog:
Initial release of backup-douyin-chat.

- Enables safe local backup of Douyin/抖音 group and private chat history via CLI tool.
- Supports login by QR code, conversation listing, full & incremental backups, and export to JSON, JSONL, or HTML.
- Provides workflow for media backup, backup completeness verification, and audit handling.
- Enforces strong privacy boundaries: all data and account state remain local, with sensitive material protected.
- Guides user reporting with clear outcome details, including status, message counts, media handling, and export locations.
